name: ANSI/IEEE normally-open limit switch symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for normally-open limit switch, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The NO limit-switch form links a discrete contact to mechanical position or travel. Its electrical state is only interpretable after the drawing identifies the actuated equipment position and the switch's reference condition.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Locate the mechanism position that closes the contact.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A limit switch senses equipment movement; a manually operated pushbutton supplies an operator command.
